title: Brane cluster gases: verification suite, figure scripts and audit of the ultraviolet-finite theory
description:
Source, verification suites and figure scripts for three manuscripts by Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya, prepared for Physical Review D.

Brane cluster gases and ghost-free form factors for quantum gravity (paper/, code/). The suite checks_clusters.py runs 176 independent checks in eleven groups: the nerve complex and its Euler identity, intersection numbers on the torus, the subset-sum and Poisson generating functions, the Barnes-Rivers projector algebra, the residue sum rule and the pole dichotomy, the superficial degree of divergence, the Euclidean propagator of the Gaussian form factor in D = 3, 4, 5, 6, the Newtonian potential and the weak-field threshold, the on-shell dispersion relation, the Schwinger parametric representation with its spanning-tree bound and the closed-form one-loop bubble, and the composition of transmission amplitudes against the exact transfer matrix. The eight figure scripts regenerate every figure at 600 dpi and run a label collision test before saving.

Cancellation of all ultraviolet divergences of quantum gravity by a scale-invariant gas of branes (uv-finite/, new in 2.0.0 under the title "Finite quantum gravity from a scale-invariant gas of branes"; retitled, with both authors, in 3.1.0). Every result of this paper is derived analytically in the text; the code only re-evaluates the formulas. verify.py runs 195 checks (Python, with numpy, scipy and mpmath): the single-brane factor of the cell model, the entire exponential integral and its bounds, the form factor of one realization of the Poisson gas and its closed-form fluctuation statistics, Monte Carlo samples of the gas, the necessity of fine graining, the vertex bound and power counting, the one-loop pole matrix of the quartic operators, the Mellin-transform vacuum energy, the one-loop bubble and its cutting rule, and the Newtonian potential. formfactor_check.c runs 84 checks of the same formulas in C99 with its own special functions. verify.jl runs 114 checks in Julia, in 256-bit arithmetic with its own special functions, quadrature and Monte Carlo, and checks the angular averages exactly in rational arithmetic. PowerCounting.lean proves in Lean 4 the integer statements behind the power counting and the one-loop tuning: the merging inequality, the bound on the superficial degree, its sign for all n ≥ 4 and L ≥ 2 and for every fine graining the paper allows, and the determinants and tuning of the pole matrix. make_figures.py regenerates the fifteen plotted figures, among them three surfaces: the potential of a point mass over distance and gas strength, the superficial degree of divergence over strength and fine graining, and the time-slice covariance of the free graviton. The five scripts of uv-finite/audit/ (new in 3.1.0) re-derive by independent methods the one-loop pole matrix and its tuning in exact rational arithmetic, the superficial degree by exhaustive enumeration, the Mellin transform of the vacuum energy and its regulator independence, the Hankel test of reflection positivity, and every entry of the one-loop bubble table with a different quadrature; each prints PASS or FAIL per check and exits nonzero on any failure.

Ghosts in Poisson Brane Gases (ghosts/, new in 3.0.0), with Ushashi Bhattacharya. Every result is proved by hand in the paper: the graviton propagator averaged over a Poisson gas of branes is exp(−φ(z))/z with φ a complete Bernstein function, it has no positive Källén–Lehmann representation, its massive spectrum is purely ghostlike exactly when the brane density per unit log-mass is at most one, and a finite four-dimensional tadpole forces states of both signs. verify_ghosts.py runs 19 checks (numpy, scipy, mpmath), residues.c 5 checks in long double, verify.jl 9 checks in Julia, and BraneGhosts.lean proves 13 theorems in Lean 4 with Mathlib on the residue signs, the sum rule, the elementary bounds and the sign of the spectral density. make_figure_data.py writes the tables plotted in its five figures.
